q1.q: Is CyberSec Pro legal to use?
q1.a: Yes. CyberSec Pro is designed for authorized security testing only. You must have explicit permission to test any target.

q2.q: Do I need to install anything?
q2.a: No. Everything runs in your browser. No local installation, no VMs, no configuration required.

q3.q: Can I use it for my company?
q3.a: Absolutely. Our Professional and Enterprise plans include team collaboration, multi-tenant workspaces, and role-based access controls.

q4.a: We support PDF, HTML, JSON, CSV, and Markdown. Enterprise customers can also create custom report templates.

q5.a: Yes. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We follow SOC 2 compliance standards and regularly audit our infrastructure.
